mapper.sql: s.id, s.no, s.company_id, COALESCE(c.short_name, c.name) AS company_name, s.partner_id, p.code AS partner_code, COALESCE(p.short_name, p.name) AS partner_name, s.period_start, s.period_end, s.statement_date, s.status, s.total_amount, s.deduct_amount, s.payable_amount, s.their_amount, CASE WHEN s.compare_result IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(s.compare_result -> 'rows') e WHERE e ->> 'outcome' <> 'MATCH') END AS diff_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stl_statement_item i WHERE i.statement_id = s.id) AS item_count, s.remark, s.create_by, s.create_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM stl_statement s JOIN bas_company c ON c.id = s.company_id JOIN sup_supplier p ON p.id = s.partner_id WHERE s.id = #{id}

SELECT d.doc_type AS source_type, d.id AS source_id, i.id AS source_item_id, d.no AS source_no, d.source_no AS order_no, d.supplier_delivery_no AS delivery_no, d.doc_date AS biz_date, left(concat_ws(' ', m.name, cl.name, NULLIF(k.spec, '')), 255) AS description, COALESCE(i.purchase_unit, m.stock_unit) AS unit, COALESCE(i.purchase_qty, i.qty) AS qty, CASE WHEN i.purchase_price IS NOT NULL THEN i.purchase_price WHEN i.purchase_qty IS NOT NULL AND i.purchase_qty <> 0 AND i.amount IS NOT NULL THEN round(i.amount / i.purchase_qty, 4) WHEN i.purchase_qty IS NULL THEN i.price END AS price, COALESCE(i.amount, 0) AS amount, 0 AS deduct_amount FROM inv_doc d JOIN inv_doc_item i ON i.doc_id = d.id JOIN bas_material_sku k ON k.id = i.material_sku_id JOIN bas_material m ON m.id = k.material_id LEFT JOIN bas_color cl ON cl.id = k.color_id WHERE d.status = 'APPROVED' AND d.doc_type IN ('PURCHASE_IN', 'PURCHASE_RETURN') AND d.company_id = #{companyId} AND d.partner_id = #{partnerId} AND d.doc_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stl_statement_item x WHERE x.active AND x.source_type = d.doc_type AND COALESCE(x.source_item_id, x.source_id) = i.id) ORDER BY d.doc_date, d.id, i.seq FOR SHARE OF d

SELECT 'PRODUCTION_RECEIPT' AS source_type, r.id AS source_id, r.no AS source_no, o.no AS order_no, r.logistics_no AS delivery_no, r.receipt_date AS biz_date, left(concat_ws(' ', st.code, st.name), 255) AS description, t.qty, o.unit_price AS price, t.defect_qty AS deduct_amount FROM prd_receipt r JOIN prd_order o ON o.id = r.prd_order_id JOIN sty_style st ON st.id = o.style_id JOIN LATERAL (SELECT SUM(ri.qty) AS qty, SUM(ri.defect_qty) AS defect_qty FROM prd_receipt_item ri WHERE ri.receipt_id = r.id) t ON true WHERE r.status = 'APPROVED' AND r.company_id = #{companyId} AND o.factory_id = #{partnerId} AND r.receipt_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND o.product_line = ANY(#{lines.values, typeHandler=com.lingmao.scm.common.mybatis.StringArrayTypeHandler}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stl_statement_item x WHERE x.active AND x.source_type = 'PRODUCTION_RECEIPT' AND COALESCE(x.source_item_id, x.source_id) = r.id) ORDER BY r.receipt_date, r.id FOR SHARE OF r

SELECT 'DEDUCTION' AS source_type, d.id AS source_id, d.ref_no AS source_no, d.biz_date, left(d.reason, 255) AS description, 0 AS amount, d.amount AS deduct_amount FROM stl_deduction d WHERE d.company_id = #{companyId} AND d.partner_id = #{partnerId} AND d.biz_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stl_statement_item x WHERE x.active AND x.source_type = 'DEDUCTION' AND COALESCE(x.source_item_id, x.source_id) = d.id) ORDER BY d.biz_date, d.id FOR UPDATE OF d

SELECT x.company_id, COALESCE(c.short_name, c.name) AS company_name, x.partner_id, p.code AS partner_code, COALESCE(p.short_name, p.name) AS partner_name, to_char(x.month, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, x.month::date AS period_start, (x.month + interval '1 month' - interval '1 day')::date AS period_end, COUNT(DISTINCT x.doc_key) AS doc_count, SUM(x.amount) AS amount FROM ( SELECT d.company_id, d.partner_id, date_trunc('month', d.doc_date) AS month, 'I' || d.id AS doc_key, CASE WHEN d.doc_type = 'PURCHASE_RETURN' THEN -COALESCE(i.amount, 0) ELSE COALESCE(i.amount, 0) END AS amount FROM inv_doc d JOIN inv_doc_item i ON i.doc_id = d.id WHERE d.status = 'APPROVED' AND d.doc_type IN ('PURCHASE_IN', 'PURCHASE_RETURN') AND d.partner_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stl_statement_item s WHERE s.active AND s.source_type = d.doc_type AND COALESCE(s.source_item_id, s.source_id) = i.id) UNION ALL SELECT r.company_id, o.factory_id, date_trunc('month', r.receipt_date), 'R' || r.id, round(t.qty * o.unit_price, 2) - round(t.defect_qty * o.unit_price, 2) FROM prd_receipt r JOIN prd_order o ON o.id = r.prd_order_id JOIN LATERAL (SELECT SUM(ri.qty) AS qty, SUM(ri.defect_qty) AS defect_qty FROM prd_receipt_item ri WHERE ri.receipt_id = r.id) t ON true WHERE r.status = 'APPROVED' AND o.product_line = ANY(#{lines.values, typeHandler=com.lingmao.scm.common.mybatis.StringArrayTypeHandler}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stl_statement_item s WHERE s.active AND s.source_type = 'PRODUCTION_RECEIPT' AND COALESCE(s.source_item_id, s.source_id) = r.id) UNION ALL SELECT d.company_id, d.partner_id, date_trunc('month', d.biz_date), 'D' || d.id, -d.amount FROM stl_deduction d WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stl_statement_item s WHERE s.active AND s.source_type = 'DEDUCTION' AND COALESCE(s.source_item_id, s.source_id) = d.id) ) x JOIN bas_company c ON c.id = x.company_id JOIN sup_supplier p ON p.id = x.partner_id WHERE true AND p.product_lines <@ #{lines.values, typeHandler=com.lingmao.scm.common.mybatis.StringArrayTypeHandler}::varchar[] AND x.company_id = #{q.companyId} AND x.partner_id = #{q.partnerId} GROUP BY x.company_id, c.short_name, c.name, x.partner_id, p.code, p.short_name, p.name, x.month ORDER BY x.month DESC, p.code, x.company_id LIMIT 500
